correction: committing a host path into .ci/config.json: the repository is cloned on other machines, so an absolute toolchain path either fails there or silently builds with the wrong toolchain. Name build tools with {qmake}/{make}/{makeBin}; keep every host-specific value in the git-ignored .ci/config.local.json.
